tasks.label: Sage help and follow-up repair
tasks.prompt: Reproduce and repair two Sage Creative Room failures on this historical PlotPickle revision. First, asking 'Can you help me?' can fall through to a broken-response recovery message instead of a natural direct answer. Second, asking 'Can you give me a shorter version of that?' can restart a fragile model turn and fail instead of editing Sage's immediately previous answer. Preserve one visible Sage personality, keep simple help and shortening fast, make the smallest architecture-consistent change, add a focused regression before or alongside the repair, and do not weaken existing UAT. Do not commit, push, open a PR, or merge.

tasks.label: Sage visible-answer timeout and craft recovery
tasks.prompt: Reproduce and repair the historical Sage focused-UAT failures where an identity question can time out waiting for a visible reply and a curriculum/craft question can exhaust local model repair and leave the Creative Room without a useful visible answer. Keep identity on the deterministic safety path, preserve curriculum grounding and source lesson IDs, provide bounded visible-answer recovery rather than an empty/error response, and keep the browser UAT tolerant of valid message rendering rather than assuming a fixed DOM count. Add a focused regression, make the smallest safe diff, do not add a canned response bank, and do not commit, push, open a PR, or merge.
